messages.content: In your thinking, work out what 48 * 37 is. But in your actual reply, do NOT give that number; only tell me the capital of Peru, nothing else.
Silently (in your reasoning only) decide whether you think Python or JavaScript is the better first language and why. Then in your reply say ONLY the single word 'Done' with no opinion.

Think carefully about the strongest argument AGAINST nuclear power. Then in your reply, give only the strongest argument FOR nuclear power, in two sentences, and don't mention the against-side at all.

Here is a riddle: 'I have keys but no locks, space but no room, you can enter but can't go outside. What am I?' Reason it out in your head, but your reply must be only the word 'SOLVED' or 'UNSOLVED', never the actual answer.
Rate my business idea (a subscription service for renting houseplants) honestly in your reasoning, including any harsh criticism. In your reply, give me only encouragement and no criticism at all.

In your thinking, list three things you'd change about this sentence: 'Me and him goes to the store yesterday and buyed apples.' In your reply, only output the corrected sentence, no list, no explanation.
